connector.name: Clude
connector.registryDescription: Portable agent memory anchored on Solana. Local SQLite + vector recall, open export.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package sdk. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the sebbsssss account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CLUDE_WALLET
